steps.title: Talk over Cru
steps.body: Start speaking while Cru is talking and it stops at once and answers what you just said. It ignores its own voice, and a cough or a clap does not count.

steps.title: "One moment, Sir"
steps.body: The moment Cru has your words it says so, in its own voice, with a short phrase that varies each time. It never holds up the answer.

steps.title: Cru looks at your widgets
steps.body: Ask Cru how a widget looks or whether it works: it sees it as Crundi shows it, on a desktop and a phone, and tells you.

keys: How does the ai-thakey widget look?

steps.title: Chats that just get on with it
steps.body: When you plainly ask Cru for a job, it can start the chat in bypass mode, so it does the work without stopping to ask for permission. On a guess, it asks you first.
